subproblem.title: Tangent planes and decay planes along the Lipschitz graph (parent step 3; Simon 5.(10))
subproblem.statement: Let n, k ∈ ℕ, U, W ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} with W open and W ⊆ U, R ∈ IMRep U n, μ := R.measure, M := R.carrier, κ ∈ ℝ, ι : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+k}, ι' : ℝᵏ → ℝ^{n+k} linear isometries with ⟨ιv, ι'w⟩ = 0, f : ℝⁿ → ℝᵏ with |f(v) − f(w)| ≤ ¼|v − w| and f(0) = 0, z ∈ ℝ^{n+k}, a > 0, Φ(v) := z + ιv + ι'f(v), graph Df(v) := range(ι + ι'∘Df(v)) (Df = fderiv ℝ f). Assume (hP) x ↦ p_x is μ-a.e. strongly measurable; (hdens) unitBallVolume n ≤ (e^{κt}/tⁿ)μ(B_t(y)) for y ∈ spt μ, t > 0, B_t(y) ⊆ W; (hnull) Hⁿ((spt μ ∩ W) ∖ M) = 0; (htan) for Hⁿ⌞(M ∩ W)-a.e. x and every v with x = Φ(v), f is differentiable at v and approxTangentPlane n M x = graph Df(v); B_a(z) ⊆ W; spt μ ∩ B_a(z) = Φ(ℝⁿ) ∩ B_a(z). Then for Lⁿ-a.e. v with |v| < 4a/5: f is differentiable at v, approxTangentPlane n M Φ(v) = graph Df(v), and every subspace S such that, for some s₀ > 0 and K ∈ ℝ, ∫_{B_s(Φ(v))}|p_x − p_S|²dμ ≤ ofReal(Ks^{n+1}) for all s ∈ (0, s₀], equals graph Df(v).
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (U W : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (R : IMRep U n) (κ : ℝ) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (f : Euclid n → Euclid k) (z : Euclid (n + k)) (a : ℝ), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection) R.measure → (∀ y ∈ R.measure.support, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → closedBall y t ⊆ W → unitBallVolume n ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (κ * t) / t ^ n) * R.measure (closedBall y t)) → μHE[n] ((R.measure.support ∩ W) \ R.carrier) = 0 → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (R.carrier ∩ W)), ∀ v : Euclid n, x = z + ι v + ι' (f v) → DifferentiableAt ℝ f v ∧ approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x = LinearMap.range (ι.toLinearMap + ι'.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ f v).toLinearMap)) → (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → (∀ v w, ‖f v - f w‖ ≤ 1 / 4 * ‖v - w‖) → f 0 = 0 → 0 < a → closedBall z a ⊆ W → R.measure.support ∩ closedBall z a = range (fun v => z + ι v + ι' (f v)) ∩ closedBall z a → ∀ᵐ v ∂volume, v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid n) (4 * a / 5) → DifferentiableAt ℝ f v ∧ approxTangentPlane n R.carrier (z + ι v + ι' (f v)) = LinearMap.range (ι.toLinearMap + ι'.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ f v).toLinearMap) ∧ ∀ (S : Submodule ℝ (Euclid (n + k))) (s₀ K : ℝ), 0 < s₀ → (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ s₀ → ∫⁻ x in closedBall (z + ι v + ι' (f v)) s, ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i : Fin (n + k), ‖(approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - S.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) ∂R.measure ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (K * s ^ (n + 1))) → S = LinearMap.range (ι.toLinearMap + ι'.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ f v).toLinearMap)
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: parent proof step 3 (the full-measure set G of parameters with (i) differentiability, (ii) T_{Φ(v)}M = graph Df(v), (iii) the Lebesgue-point property, and p_{S_v} = p_{graph Df(v)}), with the null-set transfer of parent step 1. In the parent, (hP), (hdens), (hnull), (htan) are supplied by the siblings tangent_projection_measurable, monotonicity, support_null and graph_tangent (base point z, L = 1/4). Siblings of this decomposition used: graph_pushforward (Submission.dorag_gc_graph_map_volume_le_measure) and decay_plane (Submission.dorag_gc_decay_plane_eq_approxTangent).
1. (Geometry.) f is ¼-Lipschitz, so f and Φ are continuous. Φ(v) − z = ιv + ι'f(v), hence |Φ(v) − z|² = |v|² + |f(v)|² ≤ (17/16)|v|² (|f(v)| = |f(v) − f(0)| ≤ |v|/4). For |v| < 4a/5, |Φ(v) − z|² < (17/25)a² < a², so Φ(v) ∈ Φ(ℝⁿ) ∩ B_a(z) = spt μ ∩ B_a(z) ⊆ spt μ ∩ W. Let Ω' := B̆ⁿ_{4a/5}(0).
2. (Transfer.) graph_pushforward with A := Ω' (hypotheses: orthogonality, continuity of f, (hnull), step 1) gives Φ_#(Lⁿ⌞Ω') ≤ μ⌞Φ(Ω') ≤ μ. Hence every property holding for μ-a.e. x holds Φ_#(Lⁿ⌞Ω')-a.e., so it holds at Φ(v) for Lⁿ-a.e. v ∈ Ω' (ae_mono, ae_of_ae_map, ae_restrict_iff').
3. (htan for μ.) μ⌞W = ((Hⁿ⌞M)⌞W).withDensity θ = (Hⁿ⌞(M ∩ W)).withDensity θ ≪ Hⁿ⌞(M ∩ W). So for μ-a.e. x: x ∈ W ⇒ for all v with x = Φ(v), f is differentiable at v and approxTangentPlane n M x = graph Df(v).
4. (Decay planes.) decay_plane (with W open, W ⊆ U, (hP), (hdens)) gives: for μ-a.e. x ∈ W, every S with a decay bound at x equals approxTangentPlane n M x.
5. (Conclusion.) Apply step 2 to the conjunction of steps 3 and 4. For Lⁿ-a.e. v ∈ Ω' both hold at x = Φ(v) ∈ W (step 1). Step 3 with the witness v gives differentiability at v and approxTangentPlane n M Φ(v) = graph Df(v); step 4 gives, for every S with a decay bound at Φ(v), S = approxTangentPlane n M Φ(v) = graph Df(v). ∎
